status: isolated material adapter; not a rendered KCC floor

input.role: 10 floor tile; 11 exterior horizontal tile; 12 interior wall paint; 13 dark coated metal; 14 design door
input.localMetres: Rigid metre chart; X/Z floor, X/Y wall/door, member-local XYZ metal. Never normalized UVs.
input.localNormal: Normal in exactly the same rigid chart as localMetres. Renderer must rotate directions consistently.
input.physicalFootprintM: Pixel footprint in physical metres, nonnegative. Not camera distance or screen UV.
input.stableObjectId: Stable per-surface seed, preferably 0..65535. Never time/camera/random-per-draw. Not a replacement for geometry identity.

output.baseColor: Linear RGB legacy-compatible color; not a complete multi-phase BRDF.
output.roughness: Perceptual GGX roughness; renderer squares exactly once for alpha.
output.metallic: Metal coverage; coated frame at intact default remains dielectric at surface.
output.height: Metre microheight INCLUDING material-only grout/bevel profile. Does not change geometry.
output.coverageDiffuse: Direct diffuse contribution before Fresnel attenuation, especially important for R06 phase separation.
output.coverageF0: Use directly for Fresnel. Do not reconstruct from a tinted baseColor and metallic.
output.clearcoat: Dielectric top-layer coverage; both entering and exiting substrate energy must be attenuated.
output.clearcoatRoughness: Perceptual roughness of dielectric top layer.
output.cell: Stable integer ceramic cell; (-1,-1) for non-tile roles.
output.tileMask: Footprint-filtered tile coverage, 0 grout to 1 tile.
output.bevelGradient: Analytic UV gradient of ONLY the tile/grout bevel profile; not total height derivative.
output.cavity: Bounded timber microcavity factor, otherwise 1. Not scene AO.

evidence.observedAppearance: Parent inspected KCC source photograph and reports pale horizontal exterior tiles plus dark metal side-opening frame. The photograph is not imported here.
